objective: Test whether a single characteristic-kernel dependence score ranks continuous representations by the frozen best-head envelope without the local-versus-global scale trade-off of fixed neighbor graphs.

ancestry.outcome_use: Prior results motivate only the frozen kernel formulation. Ranking outcomes are recomputed on new seeds.

reference_heads.envelope: Maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen nested-tuned head families.

shared_execution.folds: One four-fold shuffled KFold partition per panel, shared across every candidate and geometry; random_state equals panel seed.
shared_execution.training_only: Geometry transforms, target scaling, and feature/target kernel base bandwidths are fit on training-fold rows only.

kernel_alignment.feature_kernel: Equal arithmetic mixture of Gaussian RBF Gram matrices in the fitted feature geometry.
kernel_alignment.target_kernel: Equal arithmetic mixture of Gaussian RBF Gram matrices on the training-scaled scalar target.
kernel_alignment.base_bandwidth: Median strictly positive pairwise squared distance on the corresponding training-fold values; deterministic machine-epsilon floor if all distances are zero.
kernel_alignment.centering: Double-center each mixed held-out Gram matrix.
kernel_alignment.raw_alignment: Frobenius inner product of centered feature and target kernels divided by their Frobenius norms.
kernel_alignment.null: Globally permute held-out target-kernel rows and columns on the identical centered feature kernel using the 32-fold common bank.

decision_rule.undefined_spearman: Any constant selector or undefined panel correlation fails completeness; undefined values are retained as null.
decision_rule.interpretation: A geometry passes only if the one eligible null-adjusted mixed-kernel score satisfies every absolute, matched-current-OI, linear-probe-regret, periodic-gain, family-preservation, and completeness condition.

selection_tie_rule: Average reference performance across candidates tied for maximum selector value at absolute tolerance 1e-12.
scope: Final exploratory unified-statistic diagnostic on a new synthetic seed block. A pass permits broader validation only; it does not authorize public integration.
